item.text: {"search_note":"The strongest counterargument I found is not that Scholz sought escalation, but that his restraint could be read by critics as too cautious. AP reports that opponents argued his prudence might embolden Russian aggression. I did not find reliable evidence that Scholz pursued escalation to increase prestige, leverage, or personal power.
